## The same evidence, three kinds of decisions

[Every project starts from one question you need answered. We bring the data, the method and the reading of a scientist.]{.lead}
:::

[01]{.card-num}

### Funders and institutions

Understand a research field before you fund it, and see who is left out.

- Research evaluation
- Equity and leadership analysis
- Evidence for priority setting

[Research evaluation](services.qmd#evaluation){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[02]{.card-num}

### Biotech and investors

See who is inventing what, where the space is crowded, and where it is open.

- Patent landscapes
- Research and competitor mapping
- Partner and talent scouting

[Landscape reports](services.qmd#landscapes){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card-cx .reveal}

### Researchers and students

Find and screen the literature faster, with methods you can trust and repeat.

- Evidence synthesis support

- Hands-on workshops

[How we work]{.eyebrow}

## From a question to an answer you can use
:::

::: {.grid .grid-4 .steps}
::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 1]{.card-num}

### Define the question

We agree on what you need to decide, and what a good answer looks like.
:::

::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 2]{.card-num}

### Gather the data

Publications, patents, grants and trials, from open and trusted sources.
:::

::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 3]{.card-num}

### Screen and check

AI helps sort the records; people check the results against a hand-labelled sample.
:::

::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 4]{.card-num}

### Deliver clear answers

A short report, charts and, when useful, an interactive dashboard.
:::
:::
:::
:::

- Make your first charts
